subject: Lucidware renewal + commit increase discussion
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@lucidware.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Lucidware renewal: looking to increase hosted commit

Hi Jonas,

Hope you had a good week. Quick note — our product and analytics teams have validated a bigger slate for H2 and we expect steady growth in token consumption. We are up for renewal in late July and would like to discuss moving to a higher monthly commit for the hosted API (from 900M tokens/mo -> ~2.5B tokens/mo).

Primary asks:
- Can we get pricing for the new commit ladder (2.5B) and the interim burst policy?
- Any changes to rate limits per-second/per-minute at that tier? Our traffic pattern spikes during batch inference windows.
- If we sign early, are there incentives (prorated credits or a short-term discount) for Q3?

Attaching a draft usage schedule for reference (lucid_commit_schedule.xlsx). CC'd Amit (ops) who will own ingestion windows.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Data Products
Lucidware

Attachment: lucid_commit_schedule.xlsx (xls/xlsx)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@lucidware.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@lucidware.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lucidware renewal: looking to increase hosted commit

Hi Marta — great to hear Lucidware is scaling into H2. Thanks for sending the schedule.

Short answers up front:
- We can support a 2.5B token monthly commit on Hosted. I put together a tiered pricing/throughput proposal and a suggested burst window for batch jobs.
- Rate limits: at the 2.5B commit level we recommend a soft per-second cap of 80 req/s with token-based shaping for heavy bursts; we can raise per-customer tunnel limits during scheduled batch windows.
- Early-sign incentives: we generally offer prorated credit for remaining current-month usage plus a 6% commitment uplift credit for annualized early renewals. There may be room for a short-term 3–5% promotional credit if the contract goes to a 12-month renewal today.

Can we do a 30-minute call Thursday 14:00 CEST to walk the numbers? I'll bring a one-page SLA addendum for burst handling and a draft order form.

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference | +44 20 5555 0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 08:27:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Lucidware renewal — proposed pricing & SLA notes

Team — quick internal note following Marta's request. Lucidware (DEAL-3481) wants to bump committed tokens from 900M -> 2.5B monthly, with predictable batch spikes in UTC mornings. Key points and ask:

1) Pricing proposal (attached):
   - Base rate for 2.5B: $0.0035 / 1k tokens (net) with stepped bands at 1.5B and 2.5B.
   - Early sign annual uplift credit: 6% applied to first 3 invoice cycles; marketing promo 3% possible if finance approves.
2) Throughput/SLOs:
   - Default soft qps cap 80 req/s, 1.2M token/minute shaping; scheduled batch windows can have a temporary 2x tunnel for up to 4 hours/day if ops schedule in advance.
3) SLA addendum: propose a short clause for burst-handling (no additional charge for scheduled bursts within agreed windows; overage at standard burst rate).
4) Risk/ops: need ops to confirm evictions/KV-cache behavior with prolonged batch windows; suggest a 2-week pilot at 2.5B with telemetry review.

Attachments: proposed_sla_addendum.pdf, pricing_workbook.xlsx (I will drop the price workbook to the deal record). Can Finance provide signoff for the 3% promotional credit? Also looping Vanessa for any legal standard clause changes.

Next steps I plan: 1) run Thursday call with Lucidware, 2) draft order form w/ pricing ladder, 3) prepare DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: proposed_sla_addendum.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@lucidware.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@lucidware.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lucidware renewal: looking to increase hosted commit — terms & DocuSign

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the call earlier — helpful to align on the batch windows and telemetry points. Per our discussion, summary of agreed commercial terms:

- Commit: move to 2.5B tokens/month, 12-month term starting 1 Aug 2026.
- Pricing ladder: $0.0035 / 1k tokens up to 1.5B, $0.00325 / 1k tokens 1.5B–2.5B.
- Early-sign incentive: 6% commitment credit applied to the first invoice cycle; finance approved an additional 3% promotional credit for the first 90 days (applies if agreement signed by 9 Jul 2026).
- Burst windows: scheduled batch window (UTC 06:00–10:00) allowed 2x tunnel for up to 4 hours/day, no overage charge inside the scheduled window; unscheduled bursts billed at standard burst rate.
- Pilot: 14-day telemetry review beginning 15 Aug to validate KV cache and latency under production load; ops will share dashboards.

I have attached the SLA addendum and the order form; please review and sign via DocuSign at the link below. Once signed, we'll schedule ops kickoff and set the telemetry dashboards.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/XYZ123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-47219 (deal: DEAL-3481)

Let me know if you'd like a single redline pass on the SLA PDF — Vanessa can help with legal language.

Best,
Jonas Weber
